TITLE: Zastama Industries Periodic Status Report – FY26 Quarterly Update

We are pleased to provide this company-wide status update, outlining key progress, challenges, and upcoming milestones across our ongoing initiatives. The following report reflects the current state of several critical projects and partnerships, with a focus on transparency and alignment with organizational goals.

**Summary**

Zastama Industries continues to prioritize strategic execution and operational continuity across all departments. While some initiatives are progressing toward their objectives, others require focused attention to address current constraints and ensure alignment with our long-term strategy. This report provides an overview of the most significant developments, challenges, and next steps for the projects and partnerships that are central to our operations.

**Progress**

Leroror Lukaine, Research Lead at Zastama Industries, has led substantial progress in the early research phase of Project Nuzeor. This initiative has shown strong potential and has generated valuable insights that support its future development. Following the completion of the initial review, however, Project Nuzeor is currently paused pending review. This review is being conducted to assess the project’s direction, resource allocation, and alignment with company priorities. The goal remains to achieve completion in Q3 FY26, and the findings from the review will help determine the most effective path forward.

Pivoine Geltoett, a member of the Dankenor Analytics Unit, has contributed significantly to the refinement of our data analysis frameworks. The unit’s latest deliverables have provided actionable insights that support cross-departmental decision-making. Pivoine Geltoett’s recent work has been particularly impactful in identifying areas of operational inefficiency and suggesting process improvements, reinforcing the value of the unit’s analytical capabilities.

Kremarel Partners continues to deliver essential equipment to the Kimmoine Annex, maintaining the expected pace and quality of service. This ongoing support is critical to the annex’s operational readiness and ensures that our teams have the necessary tools to meet their objectives. Our logistics team remains in close coordination with Kremarel Partners to manage inventory and maintain smooth operations.

**Risks**

While several initiatives are progressing well, there are emerging risks that require close management. Project Vebamett is currently at risk due to delays in its critical path. A detailed review is underway to identify the root causes and assess potential mitigation strategies. The project team is working closely with stakeholders to explore alternative timelines and resource allocations to address the challenges and realign the initiative with our broader objectives.

Additionally, the upcoming renewal of the master services agreement with Satisen Labs in Q2 FY27 represents a strategic milestone. Satisen Labs is currently under a 36-month agreement, and early discussions are taking place to define the terms of the next phase. The procurement and legal teams are preparing for these renewal discussions to ensure a smooth transition and continued alignment with organizational needs.

**Next Steps**

In the coming months, our focus will be on addressing the risks outlined above and reinforcing the momentum in our successful initiatives. For Project Nuzeor, the executive review will include input from cross-functional teams to determine the best path forward. We will communicate the findings and next steps as soon as the review is complete. In the interim, Leroror Lukaine and her team will remain engaged in supporting preparatory work that aligns with the project’s long-term vision.

For Project Vebamett, we will be hosting a series of working sessions to identify and mitigate the current bottlenecks. The leadership team will be closely monitoring these efforts and will provide updates as progress is made. We encourage all team members involved in this project to remain engaged and to contribute their insights during this critical period.

The procurement team will begin final preparations for the renewal discussions with Satisen Labs, with a focus on evaluating performance, cost efficiency, and future collaboration opportunities. We will provide further details to the team as those plans develop.

Finally, the Dankenor Analytics Unit will continue to play a central role in supporting data-driven decision-making across Zastama Industries. Pivoine Geltoett and the rest of the unit are working on expanding the scope of their analyses to include more predictive modeling and scenario planning, which will enhance our ability to respond to market shifts and internal demands.

We remain committed to transparency and will continue to provide updates on the status of these and other initiatives in the coming weeks. Thank you for your continued engagement and contributions to the success of Zastama Industries.
